title: Set Their Hands To The Good Work

request.style: English, male baritone voice, powerful and steady, electric guitar, acoustic guitar, bass, drums, moderate tempo, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jerusalem lies in ruins now
The gates have burned with fire
A disgrace upon the land
But hear the call to higher
Nehemiah speaks to the crowd
With a gracious hand
The king has spoken his word
Now is the time to stand

[Pre-Chorus]
So they set their hands to the work
The good work they began
From the shadow of the past
To the strength of the man

[Chorus]
Azariah son of Maaseiah
Beside his house he stands
Next to Benjamin and Hasshub
Rebuilding by God's command
Son of Ananiah he is
In the list of the brave
Working on the wall of the city
Where the faithful have grave

[Verse]
Fifty-two days in the heat
The work is done and true
On the twenty-fifth of Elul
The wall stands firm and new
Our enemies hear the news
Their confidence sinks low
They know this work was accomplished
By our God alone

[Chorus]
Azariah son of Maaseiah
Beside his house he stands
Next to Benjamin and Hasshub
Rebuilding by God's command
Son of Ananiah he is
In the list of the brave
Working on the wall of the city
Where the faithful have grave

[Bridge]
The nations around were afraid
When the wall rose high
For they knew the hand of the Lord
Was the one who did this

[Outro]
So we set our hands to the good work
And the wall rises high
